correctness.rationale: PASS: Joint spectral idempotents Q_a of any commuting tuple yield an invertible unitriangular U=sum Q_aD_a and simultaneous fixed-diagonal conjugacy; its stabilizer has q^(comparable pairs of equal joint colors), so each coloring fiber has q^e tuples. On a chain e=(n^2-sum_i m_i^2)/2, giving A_(2^t)(n,q) and denominator A_2(n,q)^t exactly. Setting m_i=n/r+delta_i, r=2^t, isolates q^((r-1)n^2/(2r))q^(-sum delta_i^2/2); fixed-r multinomial Stirling yields r^(n+r/2)(2 pi n)^(-(r-1)/2), and summable theta tails give relative O(1/n). Division produces mu=(r-t-1)/2 and kappa=(t-2)/4+1/(2r), with the stated residue theta quotient. Independent finite explicit word/color-count versus multinomial computations matched n<=5, q=2,3 and t=1,2. This does not prove asymptotics, which follow from the argument.
